text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having missed out on victory in the 
Satsuki Sho, Smart Falcon was unable to 
take center stage in the Winning Live.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shaking off her frustration, she takes the 
stage with a smile. On that platform, she 
felt her dream taking a clear, tangible 
shape.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Winning a dirt race—specifically a GⅠ that 
can only be challenged in the Classic year 
just like the Satsuki Sho—she resolves to 
take center stage at the live performance 
next time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her goal: the Japan Dirt Derby. They 
decided on one of the few Classic-tier GⅠ 
dirt races as her next stage.
